newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian debt futures soar as RBA cuts rates.
newsitem.headline: Australian debt futures soar as RBA cuts rates.

text.p: Australian debt futures soared after the Reserve Bank surprised the market and cut official interest rates by 50 basis points to 5.5 percent.
The June bill contract rocketed to 94.50 from 94.16 just before the announcement, while the June 10-year bond contract rose to 92.500 from 92.310.

Speculation of an easing had gathered pace prior today's announcement after Thursday's downward revision in annual wages growth to 4.3 percent and back below the Reserve Bank's 4.5 percent comfort zone, although few expected it to happen before the next RBA board meetng on June 3.

The Reserve Bank said the wages data seemed to be consistent with satisfactory inflation, which they expected to fall below 2.0 percent in underlying terms in the coming quarters. It also said that employment growth was still subdued and that economic growth was unlikely to put upward pressure on inflation.
